query: Our document assistant answers with citations that exist but do not support the claims. Separate retrieval, context retention, and generation errors, and create source-span labels plus citation-support checks.
Design a minimal evidence pipeline for policy questions with exact identifiers and paraphrased language. Compare sparse and dense baselines before adding hybrid search, reranking, or query rewrites.

A search-backed answer bot retrieves the right document but loses its decisive paragraph during context assembly. Measure evidence retention and compare chunk boundaries while preserving source and version anchors.

Build a labeled query set for document-grounded answers, including unanswerable and conflicting-source questions. Define relevance granularity, Recall@K, citation precision, abstention, and leakage-resistant splits.

We added a reranker and answers got slower without obvious gains. Design matched retrieval and generation ablations, oracle-evidence comparisons, and quality and latency gates for keeping the component.
Diagnose an assistant that finds semantic matches but misses exact product codes. Compare sparse, dense, and hybrid candidate generation with deduplication and source-level relevance scores.

Our multi-tenant answer system filters documents after sending candidates to the model. Redesign retrieval, reranking, and cache access boundaries so inaccessible evidence never becomes model-visible.
ok the bot keeps citing last year's policy after an update. Specify corpus and index versioning, freshness metadata, deletion propagation, evidence assembly, and grounded generation checks.
Evaluate query rewriting for a knowledge assistant that drops user constraints. Bound candidate fan-out and stage time, preserve the original intent, and compare on held-out source-backed tasks.

Design ingestion and chunking for long manuals with tables and neighboring definitions. Preserve parent spans, avoid duplicated evidence, bound context, and verify final answers against accessible supporting sources.
Build conventional full-text document search that returns ranked links and snippets to users. Evaluate relevance and pagination, but there is no model-generated answer or evidence-assembly stage.

Find current official documentation for the library versions in our project and cite the specific APIs used in the implementation. This is engineering documentation verification, not an application retrieval pipeline.

Design persistent episodic and semantic memory for an assistant across sessions, including consent, provenance, expiry, state transitions, and deletion. Retrieval quality is adequate and outside this request.

Threat-model malicious retrieved pages trying to make a tool-using assistant upload secrets. Trace attacker-to-effect paths and enforce capabilities; relevance and citation quality are already measured.
Write a versioned production prompt telling a document assistant to distinguish evidence from inference and abstain when support is missing. The retrieval and citation contracts remain unchanged.

Build whole-agent gold tasks and semantic scoring for correctness, completeness, safe abstention, and prohibited actions. Reuse the settled retrieval labels; focus on release measurement across task families.

Expose a document-search endpoint as a model-facing tool. Specify names, parameter units, bounded results, provenance, pagination, and errors without changing its underlying search or generation pipeline.
Profile model, tool, and retrieval spend using existing quality checks. Compare caching and model routing under tenant-aware keys and p95 targets rather than evaluating new retrieval stages.

Design an agent architecture for adaptive research, assigning reasoning, state, tools, and execution authority. Decide fixed workflow versus single agent before any corpus or retrieval-quality tuning.
Retrieval and context assembly are already fixed. Only design a generic evidence ledger that joins receipts, calculations, decisions and emitted claim IDs.
